result.summary: The page is largely well-composed: header, search, category chips, promo banner, carousels and bottom nav all render correctly. The partially visible carousel item at the right edge ('Trattoria Piccol...') and the card cut off at the bottom viewport edge are expected scroll affordances and not defects. One minor cosmetic issue was found: a category chip is clipped at the right edge of the filter row without any fade or scroll indicator, which reads as an abrupt cut rather than an intentional scroll hint.

issues.description: The horizontally scrollable category chip row ends with a sliver of an unnamed chip clipped at the right screen edge with no gradient fade or scroll indicator, making the cut look accidental rather than signaling scrollability.
issues.suggestion: Add a right-edge fade mask or a subtle scroll hint (e.g., chevron or shadow) so users understand the chip row scrolls horizontally, and ensure consistent edge treatment with the restaurant carousel.
